title: Quantitative stratification and optimal regularity for stationary $J$-holomorphic maps
summary: In this paper, we give an alternate proof of the $ε$-regularity theorem of Wang [Comm. Cont. Math. 2003] for weakly $J$-holomorphic maps by adapting the conservation law approach of Rivière [Invent. Math. 2007]. Then we adapt the powerful quantitative stratification method of Naber--Valtorta [Ann. Math. 2017] to obtain optimal volume estimates and rectifiability for the quantitative strata of stationary $J$-holomorphic maps.
